title: Plugins
intro: Skills and connections let the assistant do more. Everything you turn on here still goes through the same reviews — the assistant only proposes, you decide.

sections.builtinHelp: Skills shipped with the app, used automatically per chat mode — always on, view only.

empty.yours: No plugins yet. Click "Add" or pick one from Suggested.

describe.gmail: The assistant reads, summarizes and drafts replies — drafts always need your approval, nothing is sent.
describe.telegram: The assistant reads the chats you pick and drafts messages — nothing is sent.
describe.agents: Let Claude Code, Claude Desktop or another MCP client ask the assistant (new agents need your approval first).

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDialog.skill: The skill is deleted from this computer. To use it again, install it from a folder / .zip.
removeDialog.mcp: The server is deleted along with its saved secrets and "always allow" tools.

detail.notFound: Plugin not found (it may have been removed).

store.skillNote: Skill from plugin "{{plugin}}" installed from the store. Used only when you name it ("use skill <name>"), never in scheduled runs. To remove: Discover tab → Uninstall.
store.modified: The skill files were changed / deleted outside the app — the skill is not used. Reinstall it on the Discover tab.
store.intro: Text-only skills from GitHub stores. Preview before installing; the app never runs bundled scripts / hooks.

errors.rate_limited: GitHub is rate-limiting — try again at {{time}} (showing the saved list).
errors.not_found: Repository / branch not found on GitHub.
errors.plugin_not_found: The plugin is no longer in the source.
errors.too_large: The plugin exceeds the limits — cannot install.
errors.no_skills: This plugin has no usable skills (the app installs text-only skills).
errors.preview_expired: The preview expired — open it again.
errors.source_removed: The plugin's source was removed — it can't be updated.
errors.install_failed: Install failed — the previous version (if any) is kept.

store.noSources: No sources yet. Click "Sources" to add a GitHub marketplace repository.
store.uninstallBody: Removes the skills: {{skills}} and the version record. Conversations and memories are kept.

unsupported.not_github: not on GitHub — not supported yet

preview.title: Install plugin "{{name}}"
preview.loading: Downloading the exact version from GitHub…
preview.userSourceWarning: Plugin from a source you added — not reviewed. Read the skill content carefully before installing.
preview.rules: Only text skills (.md, .txt, .json) are installed. Scripts, hooks and binaries are always dropped and never run. Store skills are used only when you name them, never in scheduled runs, and grant the assistant no extra permissions.
preview.warningsHint: This doesn't block installing — it's for you to check. An unknown skill may try to push the assistant to act against your intent.

warnings.injection: text that may push the assistant to ignore its rules: "{{excerpt}}"
warnings.missing_file: mentions {{target}} — that file isn't installed (script / dropped), the skill may not work as intended

conflict.builtin: Same name as a built-in skill — this skill won't be installed.
conflict.user: Same name as a skill you installed — this skill won't be installed (rename / remove the other first).
conflict.plugin: Same name as another plugin's skill — this skill won't be installed.

ignored.title: Parts of the plugin the app does NOT use
ignored.other: {{count}} other files outside the skill folders

store.sourcesHelp: Public GitHub repositories with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Default sources are reviewed by the app owner; sources you add are your responsibility.
store.removeSourceHint: Removing a source keeps plugins installed from it (labelled "Source removed"), but they can't be updated.
store.addSource: Add a source (owner/repo or GitHub link)
store.addSourceWarning: I understand: this source isn't reviewed; its skills are written by strangers and may contain text that tries to push the assistant. I'll read carefully before installing.

skipped.not_text: Dropped (script / not a text file — never run): {{files}}
skipped.lock_file: Dropped (package-manager lock file — not skill content, not scanned): {{files}}

failReasons.locked: The folder or a file is open in another program (Explorer, an editor, a terminal…). Close it and try again.
failReasons.write_failed: Could not write to disk (out of space or no permission).
failReasons.hash_mismatch: A file changed right after being written (antivirus / sync tool?) — not installed.
failReasons.too_many_files: The plugin has more than {{limit}} files — too large to read.
failReasons.too_many_bytes: The plugin exceeds the read limit ({{limit}} bytes). Largest file:
failReasons.archive_too_big: The archive from GitHub is over 40 MB:

mcp.title: MCP servers ({{count}})
mcp.hint: Servers on the Internet the assistant uses as tools. Tick each server whose domain you trust — unticked servers are not installed. Installed servers stay OFF; turning one on shows its tool list first, and every call asks you.
mcp.stdio: runs a command on this computer — not installed automatically
mcp.notPinned: The command is not pinned to a version (each run may be different code), so it cannot be added from here.
mcp.oauth: Requires OAuth sign-in for this address (the server answered 401 with sign-in details) — not supported yet.

reason.sse: SSE servers are not supported yet.
reason.variables: The address uses environment variables — not supported yet.

mcp.maybeAuth: The server answered "not signed in" when probed — it may need sign-in. You can still install it; turning it on checks again.

mcpReview.title: Turn on {{name}}
mcpReview.loading: Connecting to {{host}} for its tool list…
mcpReview.intro: These are the tools {{host}} offers the assistant. Read the descriptions before turning it on — they are instructions the assistant will read.
mcpReview.url: The server address changed with the plugin update — review before turning on.
mcpReview.tools: The tool list / descriptions changed since you approved them — the server was turned off.
mcpReview.expired: This review expired — close and open it again.

errors.oauth_required: The server requires OAuth sign-in — not supported yet.
errors.unauthorized: The server refused (code {{detail}}) — check the token.
errors.redirect_blocked: The server redirected to another domain ({{detail}}) — blocked.
